subject: General Aptitude: Quantitative Aptitude
questionTextRaw: A container originally contains litres of pure spirit. From this container, litre of spirit replaced with litre of water. Subsequently, litre of the mixture is again replaced with litre of water and this process is repeated one more time. How much spirit is now left in the container? A.   litres                                                                 B.   litres C. litres                                                                   D.   litres
